units.source_text: 此时小皇子已睡。

en.t: By this time, the little prince had already fallen asleep.

units.source_text: 命妇禀道：“本当拜见小皇子，将详情复奏。

en.t: The court lady reported, "I ought to have paid my respects to the little prince and then reported the details back to His Majesty.

units.source_text: 但万岁爷专候回音，不便迟归。”急欲告辞。

en.t: But His Majesty is waiting especially for my reply, so I cannot conveniently return late." She was eager to take her leave.

units.source_text: 太君道：“近来悼念亡女，心情郁结，苦不堪言。

en.t: The lady said, "Lately I have been mourning my dead daughter; my heart is knotted with grief, and the suffering is beyond words.

units.source_text: 颇思对知己之人罄谈衷曲，俾得略展愁怀。

en.t: I have longed to pour out all that is in my heart to someone who understands me, so that my sorrow might ease a little.

units.source_text: 公余之暇，务请常常惠临，不胜盼感。

en.t: Whenever your duties leave you some free time, please do come often; I shall look forward to it with deepest gratitude.

units.source_text: 回思年来每次相见，都只为欢庆之事。

en.t: Thinking back, whenever we have met in recent years, it has always been for some happy celebration.

units.source_text: 此次为传递此可悲之书柬而相见，实非所望。

en.t: To meet this time for the delivery of such a sorrowful letter is truly not what I ever wished.

units.source_text: 都缘妾身命薄，故遭此苦厄也。

en.t: It is all because my own fate is poor that I have met with such misery.

units.source_text: 亡女初诞生时，愚夫妇即寄与厚望，但愿此女为门户增光。

en.t: When my late daughter was first born, my husband and I placed great hopes in her, wishing only that she would bring honor to our house.

units.source_text: 亡夫大纳言弥留之际，犹反复叮嘱道：

en.t: Even on his deathbed, my late husband, the Great Counselor, repeatedly urged me, saying:

units.source_text: ‘此女入宫之愿望，务必实现，切勿因我死而丧失锐气。’

en.t: "You must fulfill the wish to send this girl into the palace; do not lose heart because I have died."

units.source_text: 我也想到：家无有力之后援人，入宫后势必遭受种种不幸。

en.t: I too thought that, since our family had no powerful supporter, she would surely suffer all kinds of misfortune after entering the palace.

units.source_text: 只因不忍违反遗嘱，故而令其入宫。

en.t: Only because I could not bear to go against his last wish did I have her enter the palace.

units.source_text: 岂料入侍之后，荷蒙主上过分宠幸，百般怜惜，无微不至。

en.t: Who could have expected that, after she entered service, His Majesty would favor her so excessively and cherish her in every possible way, with nothing overlooked.

units.source_text: 亡女也不敢不忍受他人种种不近人情之侮辱，而周旋于群妃之间。

en.t: My late daughter had no choice but to endure every kind of heartless insult from others while moving among the many consorts.

units.source_text: 不料朋辈妒恨之心，日积月累，痛心之事，难于尽述。

en.t: Unexpectedly, the jealousy and resentment of her peers accumulated day by day and month by month; the painful matters are too many to recount.

units.source_text: 忧能伤人，终于惨遭夭死。

en.t: Grief can wound a person, and in the end she tragically died young.

units.source_text: 昔日之深恩重爱，反成了怨恨之由。

en.t: The deep favor and great love of former days instead became the cause of resentment.

units.source_text: ——唉，这原不过是我这伤心寡母的胡言乱道而已。”

en.t: Ah, after all, this is only the rambling nonsense of a grief-stricken widowed mother."

units.source_text: 太君话未说完，一阵心酸，泣不成声。

en.t: Before the lady had finished speaking, a surge of sorrow overcame her, and she wept until she could no longer form words.

units.source_text: 此时已到深夜了。

en.t: By then, it was already deep into the night.
